observation_indicators.observable_fil: Sa dalawang fictional case, ipinaliliwanag ang pagsasanay, boluntaryong primary health care at akreditasyon ayon sa RA 7883; pinapangalanan ang local health board at inihihiwalay ang support; pumipili ng contact/ebidensiya sa pag-verify nang walang unsupported claim.
observation_indicators.observable_en: On both fictional cases, explains training, voluntary community primary health care and accreditation under RA 7883; identifies the local health board and distinguishes support; chooses a contact/evidence verification step without unsupported claims.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Ginagawang akreditasyon ang karanasan o nangangako ng benepisyo/appointment; kulang ang batayan, awtoridad o pag-verify.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Treats experience as accreditation or promises benefits/appointment; lacks the legal basis, authority or verification.

levels.kaya_na_fil: Naipapaliwanag ang tatlong legal na bahagi, tamang awtoridad at hakbang sa pag-verify sa dalawang kaso nang walang prompt.
levels.kaya_na_en: Explains all three legal elements, the proper authority and verification step on both cases without prompts.
levels.kailangan_practice_fil: Tama ang direksiyon ngunit kailangan ng prompt sa legal na bahagi, awtoridad o contact/ebidensiya.
levels.kailangan_practice_en: Direction is sound but needs prompts for legal elements, authority or contact/evidence.
levels.hindi_pa_fil: Ipinapalagay ang katayuan o benepisyo nang walang ebidensiya, o hindi maipaliwanag ang batayan/awtoridad; itama at ulitin.
levels.hindi_pa_en: Assumes status or benefits without evidence, or cannot explain basis/authority; correct and repeat.
